headline: Office Coordinator and Project Support

experience.title: Office Coordinator and Project Support
bullets: Run the office: visitors, supplies, filing and the managers' calendars.
Coordinate the company's branch-expansion and dealer-training projects in Asana.
Track tasks and deadlines for smaller projects on Trello and send weekly updates.
Keep contracts, permits and project files organised in Google Drive.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Handled the office mail, filing and meeting schedules.

summary: Office coordinator with four years running administration and supporting projects at an agricultural machinery distributor. I keep the office, calendars and documents organised, and I coordinate projects like branch openings and dealer trainings in Asana and Trello. I work mostly in Google Workspace.
